properties.source: traced: City of San Ramon, Orchards Vesting Tentative Map 9693 (Applicant's Project Plans dated Sept 5, 2025, approved by Planning Commission Resolution 02-26 and City Council Resolution 2026-040), sheet C3.0 Existing Conditions (PDF p. 179): the project boundary around Parcel A (DN 2000-0220096, 91.55 acres), APN 213-120-008
properties.accuracyNote: The parcel as the approved vesting tentative map draws it: the project boundary around Parcel A (91.55 acres; the City's approvals say about 92), APN 213-120-008. The CAD sheet's shape is exact at 1" = 100' (it encloses 91.58 acres at that scale); it is placed on OpenStreetMap building footprints using the existing buildings the sheet draws (trimmed RMS 0.8 m, median 2.9 m), so its position is good to a few metres. Contra Costa County's parcel map couldn't be reached to check it. 91.6 acres as drawn. The outline traced earlier from the 2040 General Plan EIR's land-use map came to 88.6 acres and lies up to 34 m from this one. The Council resolution's heading gives the parcel as APN 213-701-002, its text as 213-120-008.
